From: Liam O'Connor <liam@novaforge.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick follow-up after demo – integration blocker

Hi Soojin,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. We spun up the sandbox and started wiring our SSO + event feed, but hit a blocker with the authentication flow — our token exchange is failing when we try to call the /v1/predict endpoint. Engineering estimates another 10–12 working days to get a fix and complete E2E tests.

We were planning to finalize the pilot this week, but with the delay we’re going to exhaust the trial capacity before our integration is in place.

Would Redwood be willing to extend the trial window for NovaForge and provision a small top-up of credits so we can continue testing the end-to-end behavior once the fix is in? We can share logs and a short screen recording of the failing flow.

Attached: integration-error-log.txt, sso-screenshot.png

Cheers,
Liam O'Connor
Product Manager, NovaForge
liam@novaforge.com

Hi Liam — thanks for the details and the logs. Sorry to hear you hit that blocker. A couple quick notes:

- I pulled the log and I think I see an incorrect redirect URI in the token exchange (I'll paste the line in a follow-up to engineering).
- We absolutely want the pilot to run to completion; I can request a short trial extension + credits from our sales ops team to give you runway while your engineers fix the integration.

Can you confirm the date you expect to be able to run end-to-end tests? That will help me scope the extension window. Also tagging the internal contact who will own approvals on our side.

Best,
